jobs.description:
For a client in the metal industry, we are looking for an operator.

You will be responsible for operating the profiling line, ensuring the smooth handling of both the input and output of the machines. You will work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Your responsibilities:

• You will create registrations in MII/SAP. You retrieve production orders and transmit the required quantities and lengths to the machine. You perform the prescribed measurements, compare them with the specified tolerances, and adjust the process where necessary.

• You are responsible for packaging the finished product according to the given instructions.

• You handle the transport of finished goods using an overhead crane or forklift, including the required scanning and administrative registrations.

• You have completed a technical education and are able to operate a forklift confidently.

• A valid forklift certificate is considered a strong advantage.

• You have solid technical knowledge and/or a technical background.

• Experience with an overhead crane is a strong asset.

• You prioritize safety and quality at all times.

• You are able to work independently with a high level of reliability.

• You communicate fluently in English.

Are you passionate about metal, steel, engineering, welding, overhead cranes, or forklifts?

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators

• Forklift drivers

• Loaders and unloaders

• Overhead crane operators

• Saw machine operators

• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.

• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.

• You have solid technical insight.

• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.

• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.

• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.

• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager IT – B2B Software Integration
jobs.description:
Lead the implementation of software solutions at external clients, across functional scoping, run and upgrade projects.

Project Manager IT | B2B Software Integration | Brussels

Our client is a Belgian company specialised in integrating and implementing software solutions at its clients’ sites, recognised for its strong presence among demanding organisations.

What makes it stand out? A portfolio of strategic accounts backed by a framework contract recently renewed for six years, giving it rare visibility over its projects and its teams.

Its activity combines run, ticketing and upgrade projects on heavily customised application platforms, deployed and maintained at the client’s site.

As it grows, the company is strengthening its delivery management team and is looking for a senior Project Manager IT with a background in software integration.

The job

• Reporting to the practice lead, you take operational ownership of several client accounts and the implementation projects attached to them.
• You manage the relationship between the client, the internal teams and an external technical partner, while keeping a firm grip on the functional content of the projects.Role
• Manage the budgets, deadlines and contractual commitments of your accounts.
• Work with the business analyst on scoping client needs: challenge requests, measure them against the platform’s capabilities and decide which customisations to retain.
• Steer the external partner delivering the technical teams, and coordinate exchanges between client, partner and internal teams.
• Follow up on run and ticketing, and lead upgrade and evolution projects.
• Identify contractual, budgetary and operational risks, and bring the trade-offs to the client.
Profile
• Senior experience on the vendor side — with an integrator, a software vendor or a consultancy — implementing software solutions at external clients.
• Comfortable with the functional side of projects: you understand the solutions you deploy and can challenge an analysis or a specification rather than only coordinate. A background in functional analysis is an asset.
• Fluent English is essential; administrative rigour, diplomacy and political judgement when dealing with demanding clients.
